text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty ALERT — proxy-latency-p90 exceeded 2.0s in us-west-2 (service: inference-proxy). PagerDuty: https://pagerduty.example/INCIDENT/ABCDEFG

ashley: acked and taking. oncall here — jumping in. any customer-facing errors reported? :eyes:

mike: no inbound customer tickets yet, only synthetic canary failures. seen a short blip on canary traces at 12:34:10 UTC.

raj: looking at proxy fleet now, running quick checks:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n prod | grep proxy
kubectl top nodes | sort -k2 -n
kubectl logs -n prod proxy-abc123 -f | tail -n 80\```

raj: proxy-abc123 shows a 30s spike of elevated response times then back to normal. CPU peaked ~88% for one pod, others stable.

ashley: pulling traces — the p90s align with a synthetic canary that retried 3x around the same second. correlation id starting with `c4nary-` in logs. no 5xxs in logs for production.

ops-bot: :information_source: Auto-silence policy: if alert clears within 5 minutes with no associated errors, page will auto-resolve.

mike: can we confirm autoscaler activity? looks like burst of head requests.

raj: checked autoscaler events: one scale-up triggered at 12:33:58, new pod scheduled, started accepting traffic at 12:34:25. brief scheduling time could explain p90 spike.

ashley: ok — so timeline: canary retry flood => autoscaler spin-up => transient p90 bump during pod coldstart. no customer requests impacted (we checked request logs for namespaced customer IDs).

mike: nice. recommend keeping alert thresholds the same but add a note to runbook about coldstart window for proxy in us-west-2.

ashley: agree. I'll annotate the alert and mark as no-customer-impact. filing a quick post-check in the incident page.

sre-rotation: :thumbsup: good catch. suggest lowering canary retry attempts to reduce noise, ops-team FYI.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: PagerDuty: Incident auto-resolved (event cleared) — alert cleared at 12:37:15 UTC.

mike: confirmed clear on dashboards. p90 back to baseline.

ashley: adding notes to the alert rule and runbook: "Transient canary retry spike causing autoscaler coldstart -> transient latency bump, no customer impact. Consider canary retry backoff or reduce frequency during peak deploy windows." Will follow up with a short PR to canary config after rotation.

raj: posting dashboard link for reference: https://grafana.example/d/abcd1234/inference-proxy?orgId=1&from=now-15m&to=now

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident CLOSED (auto-resolve).

ashley: closing thread — no further action required for now. cc @sre-rotation for follow-up on canary tuning. :wave:
